name: Asahi Reika
source:
[Spoiler]The daughter of [url=/c174522]Fuyumi[/url] and [url=/c174667]senpai[/url].[/spoiler] Reika grew up in the atmosphere of love and she loves her parents dearly. She's a lively, inquisitive, and sociable girl. 

[Spoiler]She can see spirits and knows that two good ghosts are watching over her.[/spoiler]
